'''Feb'Noota''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] slave of [[Whuddle]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. When a [[Diida|fellow slave]] died from overworking, Feb'Noota took care of her body and arranged for its cremation. He also expressed his condolences to [[Vette|Ce'na]] and [[Tivva]], the daughters of the deceased, who found her just in time to pay their last respects.<ref name="Mother" />
